content.value_statement: Teams often repeat the same AI workflow design work without a reusable package. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through skill structure, resources, validation, and packaging.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md frontmatter and instruction structure.
Guides discovery of user examples before writing reusable instructions.
Shows how to choose scripts, references, and assets for repeated workflows.
Provides commands for initializing a new skill directory.
Provides commands for validating and packaging a finished skill.
Defines writing style guidance for skill instructions.
limitations: It does not design domain content without user examples or source material.
It does not publish skills to any marketplace or registry.
It does not audit generated scripts for production security.
It assumes Python helper scripts can run in the local workspace.

use_cases.title: Build a Workflow Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated planning or reporting workflow into a reusable skill with clear references and assets.

use_cases.title: Package Developer Tooling
use_cases.description: Create a technical helper skill that includes scripts, API references, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Standardize Skill Authoring
use_cases.description: Create one skill authoring process for teams using Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new reusable workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define a new skill for [workflow]. Ask for the minimum examples you need, then propose the SKILL.md outline.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a draft skill folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill folder and suggest focused improvements to SKILL.md, scripts, references, and assets before packaging.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning from several real user requests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these user requests, identify which instructions belong in SKILL.md and which resources should become scripts, references, or assets.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Release Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation and packaging before sharing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this skill, explain any blocking issues, then package it only after the structure and metadata are ready.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for weekly engineering status updates.
output_examples.output: A skill purpose statement, likely triggers, proposed reusable references, and a concise SKILL.md section plan.

output_examples.input: Review my draft data analysis skill before packaging.
output_examples.output: A validation-focused review covering metadata, instruction clarity, resource placement, and packaging readiness.

output_examples.input: Plan resources for an API onboarding skill.
output_examples.output: A separation plan for core instructions, detailed API references, helper scripts, and reusable onboarding assets.

best_practices: Start with real user requests before writing reusable instructions.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into references.
Delete placeholder resources that the final skill will not use.
anti_patterns: Creating a skill from a vague domain name without concrete tasks.
Putting long reference material directly into SKILL.md.
Keeping sample scripts or assets that do not support the workflow.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create reusable AI skills with clear instructions, optional resources, validation, and packaging steps.

faq.question: Does it create skills for Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports skill authoring for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it include helper scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes scripts for initializing a skill, validating metadata, and creating a distributable archive.

faq.question: Can it decide what resources a skill needs?
faq.answer: It guides that decision by comparing real user examples with scripts, references, and assets.

faq.question: Does it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. Generated scripts and bundled resources still need normal security and quality review.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when creating, updating, validating, or packaging a reusable AI skill.
